referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset includes the dehydration of hydrated ethanol (95%) to anhydrous ethanol (99.7%). Hydrated ethanol input is modelled for the present European ethanol consumption mix. Treatment of waste streams is included.
referenceFunction.localName: Ethanol, 99.7% in H2O, from biomass, at distillation
referenceFunction.name: Ethanol, 99.7% in H2O, from biomass, at distillation

geography.text: Data is from the etha+ project (Alcosuisse, CH), adapted to RER context

technology.text: Dehydration is done by molecular sieve technology.

timePeriod.text: Data from 2002 to 2006, current technology for the production of ethanol from starch-based feedstocks. Data for the supply mix in 2016.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Statistical data published by the European Commission.
